pages.text: Heavy oil can go through a second tower. Each recipe uses $(item)200 mB of heavy oil$() and gives half of it back as heavy oil in the lowest output, which you can loop back into the tank.

$(l)5 outputs$()$(br)100 mB heavy oil, 25 mB lubrication oil, 50 mB diesel, 20 mB kerosene, 5 mB naphtha.$(br2)$(l)4 outputs$()$(br)100 mB heavy oil, 30 mB lubrication oil, 50 mB diesel, 20 mB kerosene.
$(l)3 outputs (light distillation)$()$(br)100 mB heavy oil, 50 mB diesel, 50 mB lubrication oil.

Heavy oil also has uses of its own:$(li)compacted with heat, $(item)1000 mB$() makes one $(item)bitumen$(), the base of asphalt,$(li)with sulfur dust in a heated chemical vat with an industrial mixer, 250 mB makes a $(item)rubber sheet$().
Note that a crude oil tower and a heavy oil tower with the same number of outputs never mix up: the controller picks the recipe that matches the fluid in its tank.
